command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; test "$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 224 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 3; OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p2-flowon-20260912"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/p2-flowon-initial.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/p2-flowon-initial.xml "$OUT/initial.xml" >/dev/null; if grep -q 'text="Paused"' "$OUT/initial.xml"; then python3 -c "import re,subprocess,pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('$OUT/initial.xml').read_text(); m=re.search(r'content-desc=\"Scan\"[^>]*bounds=\"\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\"',s); assert m,'Scan button not found'; x=(int(m.group(1))+int(m.group(3)))//2; y=(int(m.group(2))+int(m.group(4)))//2; subprocess.check_call(['adb','-s','$SERIAL','shell','input','tap',str(x),str(y)])"; fi; sleep 20; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/p2-flowon-a.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/p2-flowon-a.xml "$OUT/a.xml" >/dev/null; test "$(grep -o 'text="Seen ' "$OUT/a.xml" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -gt 0; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye reset >/dev/null || true; SIZE=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell wm size | tail -n1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+x[0-9]+' | tail -n1); W=${SIZE%x*}; H=${SIZE#*x}; X=$((W/2)); Y1=$((H*78/100)); Y2=$((H*32/100)); for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y1 $X $Y2 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y2 $X $Y1 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye > "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt"; grep -E 'Total frames rendered|Janky frames|50th percentile|90th percentile|95th percentile|99th percentile' "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt"; FRAMES=$(grep 'Total frames rendered:' "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt" | head -n1 | awk '{print $4}'); test "${FRAMES:-0}" -gt 0; PID=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell logcat -d --pid="$PID" -t 1200 > "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException' "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo P2_FLOWON_PHYSICAL_PASS
